# clavis admin

<p class="cli-lead">Instance administration</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis admin <command>
```

</div>

Maintenance commands that work on the database and keys directly. Run
them on the server (`docker exec clavis clavis admin ...`). Commands
that change keys or restore data need the server to be stopped.

## Examples

```sh
docker exec clavis clavis admin reset-password you@example.com
docker exec clavis clavis admin backup --out /data/backup.enc
```
